recorrido.las_fases_agrupan_el_trabajo_p: The phases group the work by moments, such as Research, Design and Implementation. You can create, rename, reorder or delete phases later.
recorrido.pon_un_nombre_que_describa_el_: Put a name that describes the time of work, such as “Design”. Then you can assign each task to any of the phases you have created.
recorrido.el_equipo_permite_asignar_resp: The team allows you to assign responsibility and know who is working on each task. You can add or remove members from the project.
recorrido.usa_un_nombre_o_identificador_: Use a name or identifier to recognize that person in the project; for example, “Laura – research”. It’s just test information on this route.
recorrido.en_tareas_asignadas_eliges_res: In assigned tasks you choose responsible when creating them. In free choice, an available task can be taken by any member when their dependencies are finished.
recorrido.al_crearlo_se_abre_su_espacio_: When you create it, your workspace opens: there you will see schedule, tasks, phases, channels and deliverables. Everything created during this test will be deleted when finished.
recorrido.una_tarea_representa_trabajo_c: A task represents concrete work, such as “Interview users”. Defines your date, status, responsibility and the phase where it should appear; you can edit it later.
recorrido.crea_otra_tarea_por_ejemplo_si: Create another task, for example “Synthetize Interviews”. Then you will indicate that you need the result of the first one to show how the diagram organizes the order of work.
recorrido.al_abrir_una_tarea_puedes_actu: When opening a task you can update its title, phase, responsible, date and status. You also manage the tasks on which it depends.
recorrido.selecciona_la_primera_tarea_co: Select the first task as a requirement of this one. For example, “Synthetizing interviews” depends on “Interview users”; the relationship will appear in the diagram.
recorrido.las_lineas_bajan_desde_la_tare: Lines go down from the task to be completed to the one you wait for: if a line comes out below a task, that is dependency. Pass over a line to see it clearly; pass over a node to view your data or open it to edit it.
recorrido.este_arbol_muestra_fases_tarea: This tree shows phases, tasks, responsible, states and dates. A line below identifies the task on which another depends; you can open tasks or pass over relationships to review and modify planning.
recorrido.los_canales_ordenan_conversaci: Channels order conversations within each project, for example “General”, “Research” or a specific task. Send a test message: no one will receive it outside of this route.
recorrido.esta_lista_reune_las_conversac: This list brings together the project's conversations. Choose a channel to separate issues, such as general agreements, research or a specific task.
recorrido.aqui_ves_los_mensajes_del_cana: Here are the messages from the channel you selected. You can respond, attach files and use the summary to quickly recover your computer agreements.
recorrido.en_este_lado_aparecen_imagenes: On this side are images, documents and the summary of the channel. The formal deliverables of the project are recorded in the following section.
recorrido.los_entregables_son_evidencias: Deliverables are final or partial evidence of the project: a document, a presentation, a prototype, a link to Figma or a repository. Register one test with name, type and link.
recorrido.asi_quedo_tu_documento: That's what your document was like.
recorrido.aqui_quedan_visibles_los_docum: Here are visible the documents and links delivered, with their type and status: draft, in revision or final. For example, you can mark a presentation as final when it is already delivered.
recorrido.aqui_registras_materias_y_toda: Here you record subjects and all their time options; a subject can have several days or slots. For example, “Calculum” can be offered Mondays and Wednesdays at different times.
recorrido.estas_preferencias_sirven_para: These preferences are used to compare subject options according to your rhythm: start early, concentrate more credits or avoid long breaks. You can change them whenever you want.
recorrido.un_recordatorio_avisa_sobre_al: A reminder warns about something punctual, such as a delivery, class or meeting. Define what to remember, when it expires, and how far ahead you want the notice.
recorrido.esta_configuracion_define_tus_: This setting defines your usual warnings by type of task: for example, remember tasks a day before and deliver a week before. It is a standard that you can adjust later.
recorrido.ya_viste_como_se_conectan_proy: You can see how projects, tasks, dependencies, conversations, deliverables, schedules and reminders are connected. You can create an account to save your work or continue exploring this test.
